name: scene-2
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Turn the reference into ONE very simple preschool coloring page, portrait 1024 x 1536, entirely OPAQUE PURE WHITE paper with bold BLACK ink outlines. The entire background and every outlined interior must be opaque #FFFFFF, never transparent. Preserve the affectionate scene: small PinPin hedgehog kneels and steadies a large water bowl while Scooby the floppy-eared curled-tail dog lowers his head to drink; larger Papa hedgehog sits behind them and smiles. All three characters fully visible and correctly separate, with paws naturally supporting the bowl and dog forepaws grounded. Recompose vertically, dog and bowl center, child foreground-left, Papa above-left. Draw only one blanket edge and a few large simple leaves beyond the characters; remove dense forest and grass details. Intended for a FOUR-YEAR-OLD with thick crayons: heavy smooth lines, very large closed WHITE fillable shapes. Hedgehog quills simplified to a zigzag outline plus a few large shapes; dog coat smooth with no fur strokes. Only tiny eye pupils or nose can be black. No gray, shading, gradients, hatching, shadows, color, texture, words, letters, panels or border. Friendly recognizable faces, generous margin.

review.notes: Large enclosed blank regions; clear child holding bowl, dog drinking, Papa watching. No text or shading.
